definitions.explanation: The document or ticket that allows a passenger to board an airplane. Issued at check-in or generated digitally.

examples.japanese: {搭乗券|とうじょうけん}を{見|み}せてください。
チェックインカウンターで{搭乗券|とうじょうけん}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received my boarding pass at the check-in counter.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はスマホに{搭乗券|とうじょうけん}をダウンロードできるので、{紙|かみ}の{搭乗券|とうじょうけん}は{必要|ひつよう}ない。
examples.english: Nowadays you can download your boarding pass to your smartphone, so a paper boarding pass isn't necessary.

notes:
USAGE:
Used specifically for airplane boarding passes. For trains, {乗車券|じょうしゃけん} (train ticket) is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搭乗券|とうじょうけん}を{発行|はっこう}する (issue a boarding pass)
- {搭乗券|とうじょうけん}を{提示|ていじ}する (present a boarding pass)
- モバイル{搭乗券|とうじょうけん} (mobile boarding pass)
- {搭乗券|とうじょうけん}の{確認|かくにん} (boarding pass verification)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乗車券|じょうしゃけん}: train/bus ticket
- {航空券|こうくうけん}: airline ticket — the ticket you purchase, as opposed to the boarding pass issued at check-in
- ボーディングパス: boarding pass — the English loanword, also used
